i >= 0 ; i--)\n        {\n            ll ans = -1;\n            for(int j = i+1 ; j<n ; j++)\n            {\n                if(dp[j] == -1) continue;\n                ll nextone = nums[j];\n                if(nextone - nums[i] >= -target and nextone - nums[i] <= target)\n                {\n                    ll nextsteps = 1 + dp[j];\n                    if(nextsteps != 0) ans = max(ans , nextsteps);\n                }\n            }\n            dp[i] = ans;\n        }\n        return dp[0];\n    }\n\n    ll byrec(vector<int>&nums , int i , int &target)\n    {\n        if(i == nums.size()-1) return 0;\n        if(i >= nums.size()) return -1;\n        if(dp[i] != -1) return dp[i];\n\n        ll ans = -1;\n\n        for(int j = i+1 ;
